[← Advising](advising.qmd)

Each arrow points from a course to a course that lists it as a prerequisite. Solid arrows are required courses; dashed arrows mark requirements that any one of several courses satisfies. Circles are coloured by level.

![](../files/images/math_prereq_network.svg){fig-alt="Network diagram of prerequisites among Bowdoin mathematics courses, from the 1000-level calculus and statistics courses at the bottom through the 2000-level courses to the 3000-level advanced topics at the top."}

The catalogue has the final determination: check it and with your advisor before you plan on a course.
